methods.label: Sides opposite equal angles
methods.explanation: Sides opposite equal angles are equal. The sides opposite \(\angle B\) and \(\angle C\) are \(AC\) and \(AB\), respectively, so \(AB=AC\).
methods.levelReason: This is a direct Grade 8 application of the equal-angles criterion for an isosceles triangle.
